_comment: C0-16 正文英译 · notebooklm（2026-10-25）。无附加小节。正文「相关条目」3 行带 .md 链接（gemini-chat/elicit/metaso），related 写 3 条（frontmatter related 是 [gemini-chat, elicit, metaso]，键按正文链接行对齐=3）。sources 3 条对齐 frontmatter。

axes.model_access: Driven by Gemini-family models (official narrative); users do not pick models — the product form is "source-anchored Q&A", the model is an internal implementation detail.
axes.runtime: Web (notebooklm.google.com) + mobile App; processing on Google's cloud.
axes.local_files: Notebooks and sources stored on the account-side cloud; sources can be uploaded (PDF/Docs/web links/YouTube etc., official product surface).
axes.background: Q&A is instant; Audio Overview (podcast-style audio overview) is a generation task line; no "keep-running-after-shutdown" concept.
axes.tools: **Source anchoring is the product's main axis**: answers carry source citations and support follow-ups; the Studio line generates derived forms such as audio overviews/briefs/study guides (official product surface); in-notebook source management (add/remove/summarize).
axes.context: Organized by notebook — each notebook is a set of sources + conversation; cross-notebook memory not verified to an official statement.
axes.permissions: Google account system; the notebook/source-count limits differing between free and subscription tiers per the official page (not verified item by item, D9: pricing not collected); training use: the official FAQ carries a "your sources are not used for training"-type promise — check the FAQ original before quoting (not verified item by item).
axes.fit: Fits: Q&A and research organization inside a given material set (paper groups/due-diligence materials/course materials), turning long materials into audio overviews, scenarios wanting "answers only from your sources". Does not fit: open-web retrieval (it does no whole-web search — the sources are what you give it), mainland direct connection (measured 000).

runs:
This site has not completed measured runs. The coding-oriented test protocol is at [protocols/coding/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/coding/_protocol.md) (the coding task suite does not apply to creation products).

**Suggested measurements** (three, all pointing at things the official readable pages do not give):

- **Source coverage completeness for long PDFs (500+ pages)** (whether it silently truncates)
- **Audio Overview's support quality for Chinese sources**
- **Actual values of the free tier's notebook/source limits** (D9: pricing not collected; quotas measured)
unknowns:
- Notebook/source-count limits per subscription tier (not verified item by item)
- Terms-level landing of the training promise (FAQ narrative, not verified item by item)
- Cross-notebook memory (no official statement verified)
- The current driving-model tier (not verified item by item)
related: Same vendor, different product: Gemini is open dialogue + retrieval, NotebookLM is closed source-set Q&A.
Also literature-research oriented: Elicit searches academic libraries then anchors, NotebookLM only anchors the sources you upload.
Chinese-leaning counterpart: Metaso does academic retrieval + whole web, NotebookLM digs inside the source set.
